title: EV charger utilisation across peak and off-peak hours
asked: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui asked how the Ministry ensures efficient utilisation of electric vehicle charging infrastructure across different times of the day, given Singapore's land and energy constraints.
response: Ms Sun Xueling said chargers are deployed in tandem with growing demand, with care not to overbuild as technology improves. Utilisation is monitored closely, and more chargers are deployed when utilisation is high, subject to electrical capacity. Operators use idle fees and off-peak pricing, and LTA will work with them on other measures. She added that utilisation is monitored at car park level rather than per charger, that it is not currently part of tender or contract evaluation, and that mandating measures will be considered after other options like load balancing and scheduled charging are exhausted.

key_points.point: Chargers are deployed in tandem with growing demand, within space and electricity constraints.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: We are deploying electric vehicle (EV) chargers in tandem with growing demand, within the constraints of space and electricity.

key_points.point: The Ministry is mindful not to overbuild because chargers can become obsolete quickly.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: we are also mindful not to overbuild as chargers can become obsolete quickly

key_points.point: Utilisation rates are monitored closely, and more chargers are deployed when utilisation is high, if electrical capacity permits.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: We monitor utilisation rates closely and will deploy more chargers when utilisation is high, electrical capacity permitting.

key_points.point: Some operators impose idle fees during non-overnight hours to deter unnecessary occupancy of charging lots.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Some EVCOs impose idle fees during non-overnight hours to deter unnecessary occupancy of EV charging lots.

key_points.point: Other operators charge lower prices during off-peak hours.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Other operators charge lower prices during off-peak hours.

key_points.point: LTA will work with operators to explore other measures to encourage off-peak charging.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will work with EVCOs to explore other measures to encourage charging during off-peak periods.

key_points.point: Charger utilisation is not currently accounted for when evaluating future tenders or contract renewals.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Currently, that is not our position.

key_points.point: Other possibilities include load balancing and scheduled charging.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: There are also other possibilities, such as load balancing and scheduled charging

key_points.point: The Ministry is exploring electrical capacity upgrades with the Ministry of Trade and Industry and the Energy Market Authority.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: we are also exploring with the Ministry of Trade and Industry and the Energy Market Authority on electrical capacity upgrades

key_points.point: Mandating measures will be considered after other possibilities are exhausted.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: we will consider that after we have exhausted all these other possibilities

supplementary: Monitoring charger utilisation, using it in tender evaluations, and mandating differentiated peak and off-peak charging fees.
